tool.name: protein_ea
tool.description: Evolutionary algorithm for protein design using scenario-based execution

param.name: scenario_path
param.label: Scenario folder or zip
param.description: Scenario folder or .zip uploaded by the user containing the PDB (if no provided, auto-selected from docking outputs) face A, face B and MSA matrix files

param.name: scenario_name
param.description: Optional scenario name override; defaults to the scenario folder or zip name

param.name: algorithm
param.description: Algorithm name such as sea or moea

param.name: pdbfile
param.description: PDB filename inside the scenario folder

param.name: partners
param.description: Protein partner chains, for example A_C

param.name: fitness_idxs
param.description: Fitness score indexes separated by commas

param.name: face1_file_name
param.description: Face A filename inside the scenario

param.name: face2_file_name
param.description: Face B filename inside the scenario

param.name: msa_matrix
param.description: MSA matrix filename inside the scenario

param.name: complex_pdb_path
param.description: Optional docking complex PDB path to use instead of the auto-selected complex

artifact.name: interaction_optimization_outputs
artifact.label: Interaction optimization outputs
artifact.description: Generated directories, pdb files, checkpoints and statistics
